Dear SIMSONN Customer Support,

I am writing to make a **formal complaint** regarding the non-delivery of my order and the lack of response from your company.

I placed an order for a **Stimson HS Pro Shifter** on **13 January**, order number **#SSN6091**, at a cost of **£97 plus £8 shipping**. Despite being marked as delivered, I did not receive the parcel.

I contacted both SIMSONN and the courier to report that the item had not arrived. I was advised that an investigation would take place. However, since then, **neither SIMSONN nor the courier has responded to my follow-up emails**, leaving this matter unresolved.

This item was purchased as a **birthday present for my husband**, which has now passed, making the situation particularly disappointing.

Under the **Consumer Rights Act 2015**, responsibility for delivery remains with the seller. As the goods have not been received, I am entitled to either a **replacement item or a full refund**.

I am therefore requesting that this matter be resolved within **14 days** of this email by either:

* Issuing a **full refund of £105**, or
* Sending a **replacement item with confirmed delivery details**.

If I do not receive a response within this timeframe, I will proceed with further action, including **raising a chargeback with my card provider** and escalating the matter through appropriate consumer dispute channels.

I would prefer to resolve this directly and promptly and look forward to your response.

Yours sincerely,
Natalie Sandom
